# `silk/platform/windows/random`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Secure Windows random bytes without a C runtime.

## When to use
The native `OsRandom` provider calls `WindowsRandom.fillBytes`. Applications use the portable
`Random` service so tests can provide a deterministic source.
